merger_name: National Dental Care - Sunshine Dental and Gisborne Dental, VIC

targets.name: The Trustee for Care Family Dental Gisborne Trust

party_page.name: The Trustee for Care Family Dental Gisborne Trust

merger_description:
NDC HoldCo Pty Ltd (together with its subsidiaries, **National Dental Care**), through its wholly-owned subsidiary, NDC Australia Pty Limited, proposes to acquire 100% of the business assets comprising two dental clinics in Victoria, Sunshine Dental Group and Gisborne Dental Group (the **Acquisition**).

National Dental Care is a dental services organisation that operates a network of dental clinics that provide a range of general dentistry services. National Dental Care has dental clinics in all Australian states and territories, including Victoria. National Dental Care is majority owned by funds managed by Crescent Capital Partners, an Australian private equity firm.

Sunshine Dental Group (59 Devonshire Road, Sunshine VIC) and Gisborne Dental Group (75 Hamilton Street, Gisborne VIC) both provide a range of general dentistry services. They form part of the Care Family Dental group, which comprises four dental clinics, and are being sold by Care Family Dental Pty Ltd and The Trustee for Care Family Dental Gisborne Trust.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information, the ACCC considers the Acquisition is
unlikely to give rise to any material lessening of competition given:
a. there is no horizontal overlap between National Dental Care
and Gisborne Dental in the supply of general dental services
in the local area surrounding the Gisborne Dental clinic
b. there is a small horizontal overlap between National Dental
Care and Sunshine Dental in the supply of general dental
services in the local area surrounding the Sunshine Dental
clinic, and the increase in share of supply arising from the
Acquisition is expected be small
c. there are alternative suppliers of general dental services in
the local area surrounding both the Gisborne Dental and
Sunshine Dental clinics.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
